summary.plain: The team, co-led by Janet Conrad and Bill Louis, that built and ran the MiniBooNE detector at Fermilab from 2002 to 2019 to test a puzzling earlier neutrino result.
summary.technical: Collaboration operating the MiniBooNE mineral-oil Cherenkov detector on the Fermilab Booster Neutrino Beam, 2002-2019, to test the LSND anomaly; co-spokespersons at start-up were Janet Conrad and Bill Louis.
